OCW Tuesday/Thursday Ride

Irvine, CA · Road

OCW Tuesday/Thursday Ride is a road group ride in Irvine, CA. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays at 9:00 am from Bill Barber Park. About 35–40 miles, all abilities, Class 1 e-bikes allowed.

About the OCW Tuesday/Thursday Ride group ride

One of the original Orange County clubs runs weekday training rides from Bill Barber Park. You don't need to be a member to ride and they say all abilities are welcome. Routes are 35 to 40 miles and posted in their Ride with GPS library.
